roster.name: Elion
roster.description: A human priest of life in heavy plate.

sheet.stats: Human · WIS 17 CON 16 · Spell save DC 13, attack +5 · Speed 30 ft

features.name: Warhammer
features.text: +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Channel Divinity: a creature within 30 ft regains 1d8+3 HP, or makes a CON save against 1d8+3 radiant or necrotic damage (half on a success).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Channel Divinity: each undead within 30 ft makes a WIS save or is Frightened and Incapacitated, and flees. Damage ends it.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.text: Channel Divinity: divide 15 HP among Bloodied allies within 30 ft, up to half their maximum.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.text: Healing spells cast with a slot heal an extra 2 + the slot level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.text: Cantrip. DEX save or 1d8 radiant. Ignores cover.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.text: Level 1. Ranged attack, 4d6 radiant; the next attack against the target has Advantage.

spells.name: Bless
spells.text: Level 1. Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attacks and saves. Concentration.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.text: Level 1. Touch: heal 2d8 + WIS.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Heal 2d4 + WIS at range. One free cast.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. +2 AC. Concentration.

spells.name: Command
spells.text: Level 1. WIS save or the target falls Prone (Grovel).

spells.name: Protection from Evil and Good
spells.text: Level 1. Undead attack the target with Disadvantage. Uses the Holy Water flask.

spells.name: Sanctuary
spells.text: Level 1, bonus action. Attackers must save before targeting the warded creature.

spells.name: Aid
spells.text: Level 2. Up to three allies raise their maximum and current HP by 5.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. End a condition.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.text: Level 2, bonus action. A force weapon strikes (1d8 + WIS force); strike again each turn as a bonus action.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.text: Cantrip. Stabilise a dying creature.

roster.name: Zombie
roster.description: A rotting corpse animated by necromancy that lurches toward the living.

sheet.stats: Undead · 15 HP · AC 8

features.name: Slam
features.text: +3, 1d8+1 bludgeoning.

features.name: Undead Fortitude
features.text: At 0 HP, a CON save (DC 5 + damage) leaves it on 1 HP. Radiant damage and critical hits bypass it.
